newsitem.title: PERU: Lima bolsa to list Peru's Casagrande sugar company.
newsitem.headline: Lima bolsa to list Peru's Casagrande sugar company.

text.p: Peru's stocks and securities commission on Wednesday authorized shares of the Casagrande sugar company to be traded on the Lima Stock Exchange.
A decree in the official daily El Peruano said trading in Casagrande would begin 72 hours after the company formally registered its stock on the exchange.

The government and owners of Casagrande, which once was one of the world's largest sugar companies, are seeking to bring new life to the ailing company, whose productivity has declined sharply since its heyday in the 1970s.
The state owns a 10 percent stake, which it plans to privatize. Workers hold 41 percent and local private investors own the remaining shares.
President Alberto Fujimori this week urged the company's workers to consider selling their shares to foreign investors to inject fresh capital into the operation.
